decision.message: Neither family combines pressure with humidity/ambient-temperature sensing; no single-sensor substitution is authorized.

clauses.text: Please put a BMP280 and an SHT31 together on one ESP32 board. I need both pressure and humidity measurements; omitting either sensor won't meet the requirement.
